name: Fujiwara Munekio
source:
Though quite young (around 29),  Fujiwara Munekio is a Philosophy professor at the university. One day one of his students who is also a daughter of a hospital's owner hits him with her car. He is immediately taken to the hospital but when he wakes he's nothing like the person he used to be. 
Now he believes that he's a hero of justice, and all the people in the hospital are his enemies.

Favourite drink: whiskey
